title: Add LSP-backed Java import hygiene for isolate tools
wanted_capability: The isolate Java hygiene tools should be able to run a JDTLS-backed organize-imports routine for touched files when a language-server session is available, and report fail-closed when the requested LSP-backed mode is unavailable.
fallback_used: Implemented a syntax-only java.organizeImports/java.hygiene primitive that prunes/sorts obvious imports and reports provenance="syntax_only".
notes: Traced 2026-09-23: java.organizeImports and java.hygiene (crates/bro-harness/src/bindings/java_transforms.rs, crates/bbox-refactor/src/java/hygiene.rs and imports.rs) are syntax_only with no LSP-backed mode. The harness now owns a JDTLS session pool (bro-lsp Language::Java) and exposes lsp.assist, but SessionPool::code_action sends no CodeActionContext.only filter and no Java hygiene tool routes through JDTLS source.organizeImports, so an lsp_verified import organization for touched files is still unavailable.
